title: Equivariant locally constant torsor functions form a sheaf
statement: Let V be any scheme, ell a natural number, P a finite group, c:Y -> V a finite etale ULift(P)-torsor, and N a ZMod ell representation of P. The equivariant locally constant module presheaf of [def-weil-pbc-torsor-associated-module], after coefficient restriction along ULift.ringEquiv:ULift(ZMod ell) -> ZMod ell, is a sheaf on the small etale site of V. No connectedness, primality, or finite generation is needed.

proof.text: The retained restricted-scalars theorem equivariantModulePresheaf_isSheaf directly supplies the sheaf condition; no scalar transport from an unrestricted theorem is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem Scheme.GaloisCover.equivariantModulePresheaf_isSheaf
    {V : Scheme.{u}} (ℓ : ℕ) (P : Type u) [Group P] [Finite P]
    (c : Scheme.GaloisCover (ULift.{u + 1} P) V) (N : Rep.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ) P) :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf V.smallEtaleTopology
      (c.equivariantModulePresheaf ℓ N ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        (ULift.ringEquiv.toRingHom : ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ) →+* ZMod ℓ))
